elstyleSaver.innerContent:
Authorization for Consumer and Investigative Report

As a condition of employment or continued employment, Oakland Community College (OCC) may obtain a consumer report or investigative report for employment-related purposes.

This report may include verification of:

  • Education history
  • Employment history
  • Credit history
  • Motor vehicle records
  • Personal references
  • Drug testing
  • Criminal history records
  • Other employment-related information

Information from the report may be used to determine employment eligibility under company employment policies.

Consumer Rights Notice

Before taking adverse action based on information in the report, OCC provides a copy of the consumer report and a copy of “A Summary of Your Rights Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act.”

Third-Party Reporting Agency

OCC authorizes AccuSourceHR, Inc. and its agents to collect and provide the information described above.

AccuSourceHR Contact Information
11811 N. Tatum Blvd., Suite 3031, Phoenix, AZ 85028
951-734-8882 or 888-649-6272
cs@accusourcehr.com
